android.desc:
🔍 WiFi speed test, camera test, mic test, battery health, AI phone diagnostics — one tap on Android. DeviceGPT scans your device and explains the result in plain English. No root.

After every scan, tap Ask AI to get instant fixes via ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Copilot, Grok, You.com, or Replika. Raw scan results stay on your phone unless you share them; scores and phone model go to the leaderboard.

🩺 App Doctor — "WiFi Connected But No Internet"
Connected to Wi-Fi but nothing loads? App Doctor finds out why:
• Type any website; DeviceGPT tests it 4 times, so a site that fails only sometimes cannot hide
• Tests the normal connection and the in-app browser, so you see when Android System WebView is the problem
• Shows your DNS servers, whether Private DNS or a VPN is active, and whether the network is holding you at a sign-in wall (captive portal)
• Reports pass count and average latency, not a single green tick

🚀 WiFi & Network Speed Test
• WiFi speed test — download, upload, ping, jitter
• Network speed test for cellular + Wi-Fi

🔋 AI Battery Health — What Android Doesn't Show
• Battery health status (Android's reading) and temperature
• Live device power draw in watts (real physics: P = V × I)
• Estimated component breakdown (model-based): display, cellular, RAM, Wi-Fi
• App screen time — Android does not report per-app battery use, so this ranks screen time, not battery
• Charging behavior and cycle tracking
• Export battery data to CSV or Ask AI for explanation

🎤 Mic Test, Camera Test, Screen Test
• Mic test / microphone test — measures the room noise floor, your voice level, and plays the recording straight back so you hear what callers hear. The recording never leaves your phone
• Camera test — camera not working? Front and rear check, focus, colour cast
• Screen test — dead pixel test and stuck pixel test with 9 full-screen colours plus a grid for scratches. Your phone cannot detect its own dead pixels, so you look and DeviceGPT records your answer — never a guessed score
• Phone hardware test: touch screen test, plus GPS status and sensor list
• FPS and frame-drop monitoring

🛡️ Zero Trust Dashboard — Phone Security Audit
A three-section audit scoring your device 0–100:
• App Privacy Risk (35%): keyboards and accessibility services that can read your screen or keystrokes, apps reading your advertising ID, apps holding mic/camera/SMS, sideloaded apps
• Network Trust (35%): DNS manipulation, SSL

show_hn.title: Show HN: DeviceGPT – AI-powered Android device monitor with real data

quotes.text:
I built DeviceGPT to solve a problem I faced as an Android developer: 
device monitoring tools either show confusing raw data or use estimates 
instead of real measurements.

What makes DeviceGPT different:

• 100% Real Data - Uses actual Android system APIs (BatteryManager, 
  ActivityManager, real network tests). No estimates or simulations.

• AI-Powered Explanations - Share device data to ChatGPT/Claude to get 
  plain English explanations. No more wondering what "CPU usage 85%" 
  actually means.

• Privacy Guardian - Detects keyloggers, screen recorders, SSL hijacking, 
  and spyware that could compromise your device.

• Global Leaderboard - Compare your device's performance with millions 
  of users worldwide.

• Research-Based Power Analysis - Implements latest academic research 
  (2020-2025) for accurate power consumption measurements.

Tech Stack:
- Kotlin + Jetpack Compose
- Firebase (leaderboard, analytics)
- ChatGPT/Claude API (AI explanations)
- Real Android system APIs

I'd love feedback on:
1. The accuracy of device monitoring
2. The AI explanation feature
3. Privacy detection capabilities
4. Any features you'd like to see

Try it: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.teamz.lab.debugger

Happy to answer questions!
